contractSummary.LongContractSummaryPayrollNote: Since Flaherty's contract originally called for $20M in 2025 and $10M for his 2026 player option, his option year was less than 80% of the base salary for the one guaranteed year. As such, the $10M difference between the two years is assigned entirely to 2025, raising the AAV of that year to $27.5M (half of the total $35M guarantee, plus the difference). Because Flaherty ultimately opted in, the Tigers were effectively overcharged for 2025, meaning the $10 million difference is credited to Flaherty's 2026 AAV, lowering it from $17.5M to $7.5M, the inverse of 2025. The escalators for 2026 games started are then added to both his $10M base salary and his $7.5M AAV.
